title: My Agents Configuration
description: Configuration for the custom OpenCode agents plugin

agents.description: Named agents. Keys are displayed as-is in the agent tab (e.g. 'Rimuru - (Orchestrator)').

browser_automation_engine.description: Configures which skill/agent handles browser automation tasks.

git_master.description: Controls how agents produce git commits.

commit_footer.description: Add an AI-generated footer to commit messages (default: false)

include_co_authored_by.description: Append 'Co-Authored-By: AI' trailer to commits (default: false)

fallback_models.description: Models to try if the primary is unavailable or fails

mode.description: 'primary' = visible in tab, 'subagent' = only callable via delegate_task

color.description: Hex color shown in the agent tab and toasts (e.g. '#F97316')

description.description: One-line description shown when selecting the agent

tools.description: Tool enable/disable map. Set a tool to false to block it for this agent.
